description: Use this when someone asks what to check, ask or negotiate before renting a toured home, what it will really cost, or how to protect their deposit. Returns checks that could be deal breakers, safety and legal points, possible asks (repairs, appliances, rent or fees), questions for the manager, existing damage to record at move in, and costs beyond rent, all drawn from the tour and the listing. Not legal advice.

home_id.description: Exact home_id as returned in search results, for example parker-1089-114.
